L127@P3: 6. Standard Test Conditions 标准试验条件
L128@P3: 6.1 Environmental Conditions环境条件
L129@P3: Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this specification are conducted at 25°C and humidity under 65%. 除非有特殊说明，所有测试的环境条件要求如下：温度 25℃、湿度≤65%。
L130@P3: Unless otherwise specified, 60℃ is not set as the cut-off temperature，and it will not be used for other purposes after
L131@P3: the cell test is completed. 除非有特殊说明，不设定截止温度60℃，且电芯测试完成后不做其它用途。
L132@P3: 6.2 Measuring Instrument Requirements 测量仪表要求
L133@P3: Voltage meter: The voltage tester internal resistance is ≥ 10 K/V. 电压仪表要求：测量电压的仪表内阻不小于 10K/V。
L134@P3: The voltage and current measurement device accuracy grade: 0.5mV and 0.5mA or higher. 电压、电流测量仪器精度等级：不低于 0.5mV 和 0.5mA。
L135@P3: AC Impedance meter: 1KHz. 交流阻抗仪测量频率：1KHz。
L136@P3: Temperature meter precision: ≤0.5℃. 温度测试仪精度：≤0.5℃。
L137@P3: Slide caliper: 0.01mm. 游标卡尺精度：0.01mm。
L138@P3: Electronic scale: 0.1g. 电子秤精度：0.1g。

L159@P4: Charging the cell with a constant current of 0.5C and with constant voltage of 4.2V at 25℃, with 0.05C cut-off , and
L160@P4: stored for 10 minutes,then discharged to voltage 2.75V at a constant current of 1C, after that, rest for 15 minutes prior
L161@P4: to next charge/discharge cycle. The cell shall be continuously charged and discharged for 800 times at 25℃. 指电芯在 25℃环境下，以 0.5C 电流恒流充电至 4.2V 转恒压充电，恒压充电的截止电流为 0.05C，搁置 10 min，
L162@P4: 然后以 1C 电流放电至终止电压 2.75V，放电结束后，搁置 15min，再进行下一次充放电循环。电芯在 25℃环
L163@P4: 境下，连续进行充放电循环 800 次。
L164@P4: After 800 cycles, Capacity Retention = Cap(800th)/Cap(Av10)≥80%. 800 次循环后，容量保持率≥80%。
L165@P4: Note: The cycle life just can be ensured based on the charge and discharge cycle in the above mode at 25℃. For the
L166@P4: other operating conditions, cycle life will not be ensured. 备注：仅对 25℃环境下，以上述模式充放电循环，保证循环寿命。对于其他工况环境，循环寿命不做保证。

L230@P6: All below tests are carried out with the equipment with forced ventilation and explosion-proof device. Before start of
L231@P6: the test,all cells should be charged in accordance with 7.1, and stored 24 hours prior to testing. 下述试验应在有强制排风条件及防爆措施的装置内进行，在试验前所有的电芯都按 7.1 规定标准充电方式充电，

L240@P6: Crush Test
L241@P6: 挤压测试
L242@P6: A cell is to be crushed between two flat surfaces with its
L243@P6: longitudinal axis parallel to the flat surfaces of the crushing
L244@P6: apparatus. The force for the crushing is to be applied by a hydraulic
L245@P6: ram or similar force mechanism. The flat surfaces are to be brought
L246@P6: in contact with the cells and the crushing is to be continued until an
L247@P6: applied force of 13±1 KN is reached. Once the maximum force has
L248@P6: been obtained, it is to be released. 将电芯置于两个挤压平面之间， 长轴方向与挤压面平行， 用
L249@P6: 液压油缸或类似的力挤压，挤压面与电芯接触，逐渐增加压力
L250@P6: 值13±1KN后停止。
L251@P6: No explosion，no
L252@P6: fire
L253@P6: 不起火、不爆炸

L258@P6: oven. The temperature of the oven is to be raised at a rate of 5℃
L259@P6: per minute to a temperature of 130℃ and remain for 30 minutes
L260@P6: and observed for 1 hour. 将电芯放在电热鼓风干燥箱中加热，温度以5℃/min的速率由室

L263@P6: fire

L314@P7: 75℃ for at least 6 hours, and then at the test temperature of -40℃
L315@P7: for at least 6 hours. The maximum time interval between the two
L316@P7: extreme test temperatures is 30 minutes. This procedure must be

L318@P7: battery packs at ambient temperature (20±5℃) for 24 hours. 满电电池在试验温度为75℃下存放至少6小时，接着在试验温度

L328@P7: 跌落测试

L330@P7: the cement road surface at a drop height of 1 m. The two end
L331@P7: surfaces of the cell dropped once each, and the cylinder dropped 2
L332@P7: times. A total of 4 drop tests were carried out, and the appearance
